caption:
Sawubona. Dumela. Goeie dag. Gauteng greets each other in a dozen languages every day — and work should feel just as familiar, whoever you are.

That's why Workit runs in English, Afrikaans and isiZulu (more on the way), so posting a job or finding one doesn't depend on which language you're most comfortable in. ID-verified people on both sides, a safety toolkit for every job, and you pay cash or EFT once it's done. Free during launch.

One community, many ways to say hello 👉 workitsa.co.za
